idea_to_production.description: Start with an idea and continue through production verification.

poc.description: Run a focused proof of concept and stop with findings.

prd_only.description: Author or revise product requirements and stop.

design_only.description: Author or revise technical design and stop.

pr.description: Create or finalize a pull request and stop.

release.description: Assess release readiness and continue through production verification.

recommendedEvidence.description: A concise statement of the result the requester wants.

invariants: Explicit human scope and terminal instructions remain authoritative.

remedies.description: Supply the request, source references, constraints, and known acceptance criteria.

reasoning.instructions: Intake and desired outcome. Produce intake.md using the connected template and the supplied task and evidence. Submit all declared outputs. Record decisions and unresolved or deferred work through the connected journal tools.

recommendedEvidence.description: Known delivery, security, data, and operational risks.

policyGates.description: Recommend the smallest safe route without overriding explicit boundaries.

invariants: Reasoning output records evidence but never directly selects an edge.

remedies.description: Clarify the desired outcome, constraints, or terminal boundary.

reasoning.instructions: Route and readiness assessment. Produce route_assessment.md using the connected template and the supplied task and evidence. Submit all declared outputs. Record decisions and unresolved or deferred work through the connected journal tools.

recommendedEvidence.description: A scored assessment with evidence for every configured dimension.

policyGates.description: Apply the versioned readiness threshold deterministically.

invariants: Only the deterministic gate decides whether the threshold passed.

remedies.description: Revise the evidence-backed readiness assessment or request an owner waiver.

recommendedEvidence.description: The failed gate result, assumptions, risks, and proposed route.

policyGates.description: The work-item owner must accept or redirect the readiness exception.

invariants: A waiver is explicit and does not rewrite the underlying evidence.

remedies.description: Resolve the specific assumption or route decision that prevents approval.

recommendedEvidence.description: Observed user, stakeholder, or current-state evidence.

policyGates.description: The product brief is accepted before dependent requirements are authored.

invariants: The brief describes the problem and outcome without prescribing implementation.

remedies.description: Supply the missing user, outcome, constraint, or success evidence.

reasoning.instructions: Product discovery and shaping. Produce product_discovery.md using the connected template and the supplied task and evidence. Submit all declared outputs. Record decisions and unresolved or deferred work through the connected journal tools.

recommendedEvidence.description: A named uncertainty with success and failure criteria.

policyGates.description: POC findings are accepted before they influence requirements.

invariants: Prototype code is not production-ready without an explicit promotion decision.

remedies.description: Name the product or technical uncertainty the POC must resolve.

reasoning.instructions: Feasibility / proof of concept. Produce poc.md using the connected template and the supplied task and evidence. Submit all declared outputs. Record decisions and unresolved or deferred work through the connected journal tools.

recommendedEvidence.description: Accepted product context or equivalent source evidence.

policyGates.description: Requirements are approved before downstream design.

invariants: Requirements state observable behavior and keep technical prescriptions explicit as constraints or assumptions.

remedies.description: Revise the product brief or POC findings that leave requirements unsupported.

reasoning.instructions: Product requirements. Produce requirements.md using the connected template and the supplied task and evidence. Submit all declared outputs. Record decisions and unresolved or deferred work through the connected journal tools.

recommendedEvidence.description: Accepted journeys, behaviors, and accessibility expectations.

policyGates.description: Experience behavior is accepted by configured stakeholders.

invariants: Every relevant empty, error, loading, responsive, and accessible state remains visible.

remedies.description: Clarify the affected journey or user-visible acceptance criteria.

reasoning.instructions: Experience design. Produce experience_design.md using the connected template and the supplied task and evidence. Submit all declared outputs. Record decisions and unresolved or deferred work through the connected journal tools.

recommendedEvidence.description: The selected product, POC, requirements, and experience artifacts.

policyGates.description: Product intent, contradictions, and approvals are reviewed together.

invariants: Failures route to the closest affected artifact rather than restarting discovery.

remedies.description: Revise the requirement or decision named by the readiness finding.

recommendedEvidence.description: Relevant code paths, established patterns, constraints, and learning-test results.

policyGates.description: Research findings are accepted before design decisions rely on them.

invariants: Findings distinguish observation from inference and cite their sources.

remedies.description: Gather the specific repository or dependency evidence needed for the decision.

reasoning.instructions: Technical discovery. Produce technical_research.md using the connected template and the supplied task and evidence. Submit all declared outputs. Record decisions and unresolved or deferred work through the connected journal tools.

recommendedEvidence.description: Accepted product intent plus relevant research and repository constraints.

policyGates.description: The technical design is accepted before decomposition.

invariants: The design names boundaries, failure behavior, compatibility, validation, and rollback.

remedies.description: Research the named uncertainty that prevents a safe design decision.

reasoning.instructions: Technical design. Produce technical_design.md using the connected template and the supplied task and evidence. Submit all declared outputs. Record decisions and unresolved or deferred work through the connected journal tools.

recommendedEvidence.description: Accepted requirements and technical decisions with traceable acceptance criteria.

policyGates.description: The delivery and story plan is approved before scheduling.

invariants: Stories express observable outcomes and explicit dependencies rather than file-by-file phases.

remedies.description: Resolve the requirement or design decision that cannot be traced to a story.

reasoning.instructions: Delivery decomposition. Produce decomposition.md using the connected template and the supplied task and evidence. Submit all declared outputs. Record decisions and unresolved or deferred work through the connected journal tools.

recommendedEvidence.description: Stories with outcomes, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and validation evidence.

policyGates.description: Multi-story work requires delivery-owner approval before execution.

invariants: Only dependency-ready stories are schedulable.

remedies.description: Revise the specific underspecified or incorrectly ordered story.

recommendedEvidence.description: A dependency-ready story with accepted context and repository access.

policyGates.description: The child workflow applies its own story readiness and approval boundaries.

invariants: Each story executes against its pinned child workflow version.

remedies.description: Resolve the story dependency or readiness finding before scheduling it.

recommendedEvidence.description: Validated story changesets and acceptance coverage.

policyGates.description: All configured checks must pass before pull-request creation.

invariants: Failed checks follow only the bounded targeted repair route.

remedies.description: Repair the failing story or implementation point and rerun the failed checks.

recommendedEvidence.description: Passing integrated validation, acceptance coverage, and rollback notes.

policyGates.description: Repository permissions and project policy authorize publication.

invariants: The pull request describes the actual changes and observed validation.

remedies.description: Resolve missing or failed validation evidence before publication.

recommendedEvidence.description: Required reviews, status checks, policy scans, and merge requirements.

policyGates.description: The authoritative repository reports all required conditions satisfied.

invariants: External evidence is observed and recorded without fabricating connector results.

remedies.description: Address the specific review finding or failed repository check.

recommendedEvidence.description: Release notes, rollout, rollback, observability, approvals, and environment health.

policyGates.description: Production-impacting work requires an authorized release decision.

invariants: The release decision identifies rollback triggers and the responsible authority.

remedies.description: Supply the missing review, CI, rollout, rollback, or operational evidence.

reasoning.instructions: Release readiness. Produce release_readiness.md using the connected template and the supplied task and evidence. Submit all declared outputs. Record decisions and unresolved or deferred work through the connected journal tools.

recommendedEvidence.description: The accepted release decision and configured external delivery conditions.

policyGates.description: Merge, release, and deployment follow external authorization and policy.

invariants: Delivery actions are idempotent, permission-scoped, and recorded.

remedies.description: Resolve the missing release authority or readiness decision.

recommendedEvidence.description: Deployment identity, environment health, smoke checks, and relevant outcome metrics.

policyGates.description: Configured production checks determine completion or anomaly handling.

invariants: Verification records observed production state and does not infer deployment success.

remedies.description: Apply the configured rollback or incident decision for the observed anomaly.

approval.externalCondition: production health and configured outcome checks are observed
